description: This PHP file is a controller class for managing product options within the OpenCart admin panel. It provides methods for listing, creating, editing, deleting, and auto-completing product options, handling related view rendering and AJAX responses.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Controller class for managing product options in the OpenCart admin area, including listing, editing, deleting, and autocompletion of options.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to load the options listing page, set up breadcrumbs, and load necessary sub-controllers and views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches and outputs the options list by calling the getList controller method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of options with pagination and sorting, returning HTML view for display.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Loads the form for adding or editing an option, including loading existing data and related resources.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to add or update an option, performing validation and returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected options after permission and dependency checks, returning JSON results.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides JSON response for autocomplete feature, listing options matching a filter.
